about: Every map sheet that can be added from the viewer's Old maps card (or python3 start.py maps add). Nothing here is downloaded until someone adds it. Generated by scripts/map_library_catalogue.py; do not edit by hand. bounds: [west, south, east, north] in degrees, approximate (the map's own datum). urls: tried in order. bytes and sha256: the file as first downloaded (sha256 null where nobody has downloaded it yet; the size is then the server's). Scan entries also carry what the downloader needs to reproduce the image their control file in data/scans/ was made on: 'source_file', 'derive', 'work_size'.

l7014.name: US Army Map Service series L7014, with border sheets L7015 and L7016
l7014.publisher: US Army Map Service; GeoPDFs prepared by the US National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency
l7014.licence: Work of the US Government: public domain in the United States. NGA makes the GeoPDFs freely downloadable from the USGS Store.
l7014.notes: One sheet per 15-minute cell. Bounds are the sheet's printed frame (its cell, but for three border and coastal sheets) on the map's own datum (Indian 1960), a few hundred metres from WGS84; the tiles are placed from each PDF's own georeferencing. The PDF metadata carries release codes 'DS' or 'OO', the same as the sheets this project has always used; check the printed margin before redistributing tiles.

jog1501.name: Joint Operations Graphic (Air), series 1501A
jog1501.publisher: US Defense Mapping Agency; GeoPDFs prepared by the US National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency
jog1501.licence: Work of the US Government: public domain in the United States. NGA makes the GeoPDFs freely downloadable from the USGS Store; the University of Texas Libraries host the same files. Credit 'University of Texas Libraries' when a file comes from there.
jog1501.notes: An overview layer for the whole country, covering most places the 1:50,000 sheets miss. Bounds are each PDF's own corner fields, because the sheet layout is irregular. Datums vary by sheet (Indian 1960, or WGS84 on three later reprints). Some PDFs carry release code 'DS'; check the printed margin before redistributing tiles.

scans.name: Older scanned maps
scans.licence: Each map has its own terms, given with it. Some are CC BY-NC-SA: non-commercial use only, with attribution, and adaptations shared alike.
scans.notes: Placed by hand from control points in data/scans/<id>.json, so the downloaded image must be reproduced exactly (see 'derive').
